description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Externalize non-secret application settings for cloud-ready configuration management.
tasks.reason: The assessment identified hardcoded URLs in source/config files that reduce portability and operational flexibility.
tasks.requirements: Addresses issues: Hardcoded URLs detected. Move non-secret URL and endpoint configuration from local web.config settings into Azure App Configuration while preserving existing application behavior.

tasks.description: Migrate SQL connectivity to Azure SQL Database using Azure-native authentication.
tasks.reason: The assessment identified SQL connection and provider patterns in web.config that should be modernized for Azure.
tasks.requirements: Addresses issues: SQL database connection detected, Connection strings without configuration builders detected, System.Data.SqlClient dependency detected. Migrate database connectivity to Azure SQL Database and use managed identity authentication instead of embedded credentials.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate known CVEs in project dependencies before deployment readiness.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required in every modernization plan to reduce known vulnerability risk.
tasks.requirements: Scan project dependencies for known CVEs and upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched versions. If major version upgrades are required, document potential breaking change risks and verify build/test outcomes after remediation.
